buildingDefs.description: Harvests corrupted GL!TCH packets from abandoned infrastructure.

buildingDefs.description: Digs up iron ore from deep veins.

buildingDefs.description: Harvests ambient mana into crystallized shards.

buildingDefs.name: Watchtower

missionDefs.name: Iron Mining Run
missionDefs.description: Venture into the caves to mine iron ore.

missionDefs.name: Mana Expedition
missionDefs.description: Explore ley line convergences to collect mana shards.

text: The ley lines pulsed with energy!
The ley lines were dormant today.

missionDefs.name: Data Recovery Sweep
missionDefs.description: The reconstruction zone still hums with abandoned GL!TCH-BIO terminals. Somewhere in the static noise lies Dr. Vape’s earliest calibration logs. Send a PERP to sift through corrupted consoles, extract viable residue, and avoid triggering automated clean-up drones. They’re not supposed to touch anything important. They’re absolutely going to touch everything.

missionDefs.name: Quick Gather
missionDefs.description: Send your birds on a short foraging trip.

rewards.message: Well that could have gone better.

missionDefs.name: Void Rift Exploration
missionDefs.description: Brave the dangerous void rifts for rare materials.

text: The rift collapsed before you could gather much.

missionDefs.name: The Great Egg Hunt
missionDefs.description: Scramble around Derpshire looking for shiny eggs. Try not to sit on them.

missionDefs.name: Derp Mail Express
missionDefs.description: Deliver very important letters. Contents: mostly doodles and snack requests.

missionDefs.name: Suspicious Mushroom Patrol
missionDefs.description: Those mushrooms are looking a bit too happy. Investigate immediately.

missionDefs.name: Bandit Camp Buffet Raid
missionDefs.description: The bandits stole the village snack supply. This cannot stand.

missionDefs.name: The Somewhat Scary Cave
missionDefs.description: A cave that is definitely not haunted. Probably. Send a team to find out.

missionDefs.name: The Leaning Tower of Derp
missionDefs.description: Climb a suspiciously wobbly tower. Rumor has it there's treasure at the top. Also vertigo.

recipeDefs.name: Sketchy Health Potion

recipeDefs.name: Liquid Four-Leaf Clover
recipeDefs.description: Statistically questionable, but birds love the taste.

recipeDefs.description: Guaranteed to make your bird feel swole. Temporary gains only.

recipeDefs.name: Brew Healing Potion
recipeDefs.description: Brew a moderate healing potion from crystal blooms.

recipeDefs.name: Forge Iron Sword
recipeDefs.description: Forge a basic iron sword from ore.

recipeDefs.name: Enchant Ring of Focus
recipeDefs.description: Imbue a ring with concentrated mana energy.

recipeDefs.name: Turbo Juice
recipeDefs.description: Makes birds go ZOOM. They may forget how to stop.
